introduction: Minnesota weatherization helps qualifying households reduce home-energy use. Apply through the combined Energy Assistance and Weatherization process.
description: Minnesota weatherization helps qualifying households reduce home-energy use. Apply through the combined Energy Assistance and Weatherization process.

sections.who: Commerce uses the previous calendar month of household income. Its 2026 guidance uses the higher of 200% federal poverty or the applicable LIHEAP income threshold. Receipt of TANF or SSI within the last 12 months is another qualifying pathway. Priorities include older or disabled members, children and high energy use or burden; qualification does not guarantee immediate work.
sections.get: Eligible renters and homeowners may receive free assessment and approved upgrades such as insulation, air sealing, or heating/water-heating repair or replacement. The provider chooses cost-effective measures for the home.

sections.apply:
1. Start combined intake

    Use the combined online application or contact your local provider for a form or call 800-657-3710 to find your weatherization provider.

  2. Request weatherization screening

    Explain the home’s energy problems and ask which additional property records are required.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Follow the provider’s inspection and scheduling instructions.
sections.after: Ask about waiting lists and repairs that must be completed before weatherization.
sections.sources: Current eligibility, upgrades and combined application: Minnesota Commerce weatherization. Preparation and program overview: 2026 participant guide.
